stories.title: Deestriders runners complete London Marathon on record-setting day
stories.summary: Four Deestriders runners completed Sunday’s London Marathon, with a course personal best, a sub-five-hour debut for charity, more than £4,000 raised for the Alzheimer’s Society, and a debut for a runner who had just turned 60. stories.title: Mancot man jailed for 21 years for sexually assaulting child
stories.summary: A 35-year-old man from Mancot has been jailed for 21 years for sexually assaulting a child and possessing indecent images of children. stories.title: Proposed Connah’s Quay carbon capture power station – regulators say wildlife plans fall short
stories.summary: Two statutory regulators and Flintshire County Council have told the Planning Inspectorate examination of Uniper’s proposed Connah’s Quay Low Carbon Power Project that the developer’s plans for limiting damage to wildlife and habitat are not good enough. stories.title: Two overnight road closures planned at Ewloe as Active Travel works continue
stories.summary: Old Mold Road in Ewloe will close overnight tonight as the next phase of works begins for the Ewloe Active Travel Scheme. Flintshire County Council has confirmed two overnight road closures and one set of overnight temporary traffic lights, on three consecutive nights this week. stories.title: Most Welsh voters do not understand new Senedd voting system, study finds
stories.summary: Most voters in Wales do not understand how the new Senedd voting system works, less than two weeks before the election on 7 May.
